GAA crest assets

This origin serves the 92 club, 36 county and 1 fallback crest image embedded in Roscommon GAA results posts. It is a generated mirror: the service API and operator interface are not hosted here, and no image is edited in this repository.

  • crests/registry.json - the register behind the images
  • crests/README.md - provenance, sources and licences

Each crest remains the property of its club or county board, and inclusion here identifies the team in results coverage only.
